note: SAFE d'étape émis par Avride (filiale de Nebius) à SMB Holding Corporation, mêmes termes que le SAFE d'octobre 2025, classé en passif (ASC 480) ; montant en millions
quote: In June 2026, following the achievement of the specified operational and financing milestones, Avride issued an additional SAFE to SMB Holding Corporation ("SMB") with a purchase amount of $75.0 in exchange for cash (the "Milestone SAFE"), thereby settling the Tranche Right liability.
